# Frances and Kevin

> CPD-accredited marketing training for UK marketers and business owners, led live by James McCracken FCIM, a practising Fractional CMO and Chair of CIM North West. Courses run from £150 to £799, live online in small cohorts, covering marketing leadership, planning, analytics, digital PR and LinkedIn.

Frances and Kevin is a UK marketing training business based in Greater Manchester. All courses are CPD accredited. The flagship Marketing Director Course helps senior marketing managers step up to director level. SOSTAC® Masterclasses are co-delivered with PR Smith, the framework's creator.

## Courses

- [Marketing Director Course](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/marketing-course-for-professionals/): 7 weeks live online, maximum 10 learners, £799. For senior marketers stepping up to director level.
- [SOSTAC® Masterclasses](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/sostac-masterclasses/): From £595. The marketing planning framework taught live with its creator, PR Smith.
- [Marketing for Business Owners](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/marketing-course-for-business-owners/): 5 weeks live online, £399, maximum 8 per cohort. Build a 12-month marketing plan.
- [Interim Marketing Career Course](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/launch-your-interim-marketing-career/): 6 weeks, £699. For senior marketers moving to interim and fractional work.
- [AI Marketing Course for Senior Marketers](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/ai-marketing-course-senior-marketers/): CPD accredited, for managers and directors.
- [Google Analytics 4 Training](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/google-analytics-4-training/): £199. Live online, with in-person team delivery available across Manchester, Leeds and Liverpool.
- [Digital PR Training](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/introduction-to-digital-pr/): £199. Pitching journalists, winning coverage and building backlinks.
- [LinkedIn Bootcamp](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/linkedin-bootcamp/): £199, on-demand.
- [Graduate Marketing Starter Course](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/graduate-marketing-starter-course/): £150. For early-career marketers.
- [In-House Team Training](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/in-house-marketing-training-team-development/): Custom programmes for marketing teams.

## Key resources

- [Marketing Director Salary Report 2026](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/marketing-director-salary-report-2026/): UK salary data by sector, region and company size.
- [Marketing Director Salary UK guide](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/blog/marketing-director-salary-uk/): Salaries range £55,000 to £200,000+, with the mid-market at £90,000 to £130,000.
- [What is a Fractional CMO?](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/blog/what-is-a-fractional-cmo/): A senior marketing leader working part-time, typically £600 to £1,500 per day in the UK.
- [Knowledge Centre](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/knowledge-centre/): Guides on marketing careers, leadership and planning.
- [All courses](https://francesandkevin.co.uk/marketing-courses-uk/): Full course comparison.

- Frances & Kevin is a UK marketing training provider led by James McCracken FCIM.
